retainedRuntimeFinding.finding: The current iPhone passed main pages and centered private-shelf entry, then failed reader readiness with a full-page loading spinner in retained post-error AX/PNG.

problem.sourceDefect: The f4 reader awaited optional story_reactions inside the required book/media try/catch/finally. Holding that read withheld the authorized reader; rejection cleared the already hydrated book. Functional component regressions reproduce both defects.
problem.causalityLimit: The optional-read defect is independently established from source and controlled component execution. The f4 artifact does not identify which promise caused its observed loading interval, and this repair is not claimed to cure that native failure.

changes: Required auth readiness, book read, media hydration and visibility checks remain prerequisites for the book. Optional reaction reads run after authorized publication without blocking reader loading completion.
Returned query errors and rejected optional promises settle only reaction status. They do not clear the authorized book or route into its required-read error screen.

Unknown initial reaction state disables only the reaction control and exposes loading/unavailable status. It never presents an actionable guessed Like/unlike state. Valid known membership remains usable during ordinary refreshes and optional refresh failure.

A per-book/account scope object invalidates old reads and mutation completions across route/account/unmount, including account ABA before React rerenders. New required loads retire old optional-read tickets and settle unknown pending state.

Confirmed per-story revision records override older optional-read membership while preserving fetched results for unrelated pages. Both successful react and unreact are protected; rejected mutations do not replace authoritative reads.
Fresh scopes clear known/liked state; authorized results prune removed or absent source IDs. Empty and source-less books cannot carry old likes into later pages.

Optional requests use a separate ticket from full-book loadGeneration: a soundtrack confirmation can still invalidate stale full-book metadata without discarding a valid reaction response. If it invalidates a held required refresh, the retired unknown reaction read is unavailable rather than stuck loading.

tests.executionBoundary: The complete production MemoryAlbumScreen TSX and pure shared helpers, including the real soundtrack-save hook, execute under a controlled dependency-faithful React hook host. State setters, memo dependencies and effect cleanup are exercised. Native views/animation acknowledgement, timers, child UI internals, auth sessions, queries and media delivery are controlled; this does not execute UIKit, Hermes networking, actual server authorization or a native renderer.
tests.existingTestChange: memory-media-regressions.cjs receives only the new ref/setter fixture values required by its extracted native callback. All six existing native/web authorization assertions remain unchanged.

findings: Removed an optional async dependency from required content rendering; no required authorization await was relaxed.
Effect dependency identities remain primitive/stable; no new global listeners or timers were introduced.
Functional state updates preserve current known membership and confirmed mutations; transient request ownership stays local to refs.
Per-scope Map entries are pruned to current authorized source IDs and discarded on identity changes.
Unknown reaction controls communicate loading/unavailable state and are disabled; book reading remains available.
New state/helpers are typed, and the final TypeScript/ESLint checks pass.
reactReview.scopeLimit: This is a review of the changed native component behavior, not a broad React/Next refactor or new native accessibility-pixel acceptance.

untouchedAcceptance: Mandatory native navigation/capture commands and timeouts are unchanged by this repair. Supabase SDK authentication, server mutation semantics and native capture/encoder code are not changed here. Mutation tests establish UI-result ownership, not new server-side transport cancellation guarantees.
nextGate: Independent source/focused review followed by the existing combined gate and an authorized fresh full native run; no new native acceptance result is claimed.
